name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

name: Butcher Hero: Monster Idle RPG
summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph
• Make progress with AFK progression and optional auto-battle
• Enjoy the complete single-player game offline
• Challenge other heroes in online PvP

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

Claw your way out of the gutter and seize control of the underworld. Step into a gritty, cinematic world of secret hideouts, high-risk shipments, and bloody turf wars. Every choice you make about trust, risk, and ambition turns you from a nobody into a feared kingpin.

From Corner Deals To The Throne

You start with nothing but nerve. Run small deals, trade favors, and turn every win into power. Block by block, the city bends to your name. But every move you make creates new enemies, and the higher you climb, the harder they hit. How far will you go?

Grow Your Underground Business

Scour dangerous neighborhoods for rare resources and turn a hidden backroom hustle into a full-blown operation. Get hands-on, upgrade your gear, and drive up your profits. Sharpen your methods, hire people you can trust, and scale from a single workbench to a sprawling compound.

Pull Off High-Stakes Smuggling

Pick your routes, load up your convoy, and think fast when things go wrong. Run armed shipments through enemy turf. Slip by quiet or roll in heavy. Buy off the right cops, hit rival gangs where it hurts, and never trust a checkpoint. Each run grows your empire.

Turn Cash Into Power

Build your crew. Run the streets, ink wholesale deals worth millions, and launder every dirty dollar through legit fronts. Pressure your rivals into submission or shake hands with them. Spread your investments wide and keep your empire in the shadows.

Keep the Crown & Stay Alive

Power attracts betrayal. One mistake turns everything to ash. Recruit loyal underbosses, sharpen your enforcers, and root out the snitch before he moves on you. Talk, threaten, or pull the trigger. Loyalty flips overnight. Rule the underworld, or rot in a case file with the rest.

name: Rise of Kingdoms: Lost Crusade
summary: The journey of your civilization starts here.
description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression

name: Colony Flow!
summary: Lead ants, sort colorful cubes, and unlock beautiful pixel art puzzles!
description:
🐜 Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

🧠 COMMAND YOUR COLONY

👆 Tap a box to send its ants marching
🧱 Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
🕳️ Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
🔓 Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
✅ Clear every block to finish the puzzle

🎯 EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

👆 One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
🧩 Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
⏳ No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
🐜 Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
🖼️ Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

🎨 DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals 🐘, fruit 🍓, food 🍜, flowers 🌸, nature 🌿, festivals 🎉, toys 🧸, rockets 🚀, castles 🏰, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

☕ With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

🐜 Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

name: Castle Busters
summary: 1v1 PvP strategy brawler! Build your crew, smash castles and rule the arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a PvP battle game where you build your castle, draft your units, and smash your opponent's castle to pieces. Blast through destructible walls and leave their plans in rubble!

Crush other players in fast 1v1 online multiplayer battles where turn-based strategy meets castle-smashing chaos.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.

In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart one shot at a time. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes a rival. Who needs a front door anyway?

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Smash through walls and bring down their towers. 

⚡ Turn-based 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions. Make every shot count because your rival gets the next one.

🏗️ Your castle. Your design. Build a castle worth showing off, then put it to the test against other players. Building yours is almost as satisfying as watching theirs collapse. 

🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft your units: brave knights, sharp-eyed archers and bombers who brought more than enough explosives. Combine their strengths, find powerful synergies, and leave your opponent shaking more than their towers.

📈 Upgrades that make a difference. Level up your units and strengthen your castle with new gadgets. Give your crew a stronger home and your opponent a harder job.

🏆 Battle through the arenas. Earn trophies, progress along Trophy Road, and unlock Ranked mode. Battle real players and climb the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

🎯 Play your way. Pick off exposed units with precision or lay siege to their castle. Change your strategy as the walls come down and decide where the next shot will hurt most.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target. Destroy their defenses to open up your next shot, expose their units, and make their castle collapse. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

Win by wiping out all enemy units or turning their castle into rubble. Every turn brings a choice: take out a hero or give their castle a window they didn't ask for.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match units to build a loadout where their abilities work together. Plan around your favorites, experiment with different combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your units, unlock new heroes, and discover fresh tactical options as your crew grows. Your castle evolves too. Strengthen your walls and towers, try new gadgets and strategies, and put your build to the test in multiplayer PvP.

Progress through the arenas on Trophy Road, then climb the ranked ladder and clash with the best. You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you love turn-based strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, or fast online multiplayer battles, Castle Busters is built for you. Got a few minutes? That's plenty of time to make a mess of someone's castle. With physics-based artillery and walls that won't stay where you left them, it's impossible to play the same way twice.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

name: Lordrush
summary: Medieval Tower Defense Game.
description:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.


• Fight for Resources
Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

• Build Fortress Walls
Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

• Upgrade Towers
Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

• Strengthen Your Fortress
As enemy attacks grow stronger, reinforce your walls, expand your towers, and turn your settlement into a powerful medieval stronghold.

• Defend Against Sieges
Enemies attack your fortress in waves. Adjust your defenses based on enemy routes and strength, and hold the line.

• Recruit Heroes
Recruit medieval heroes with different abilities. Deploy them to change the course of battle.

• Make Tactical Choices
Every building, upgrade, and hero deployment can affect the outcome. Plan carefully to survive the next siege.

• Manage Your People
Assign survivors as workers, hunters, or cooks to maintain resource production, food supplies, and daily fortress operations.

• Maintain Health and Order
Your people’s condition affects productivity. Keep food stocked, maintain stability, and help your fortress continue to grow.

• Issue Decrees
Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

• Join Alliances
Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

• Challenge Other Lords
Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

• Claim the Throne
Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

name: Age of Spirits
summary: Lead Your Tribe Against the Dark.
description:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire: Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map: March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances: Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

SPECIAL NOTES

· Network connection is required.

name: Hero Wars: Alliance
summary: Lendas nascem aqui: lute em guerras épicas de RPG ocioso, colete heróis e vença!
description:
Hero Wars: Alliance é um RPG clássico de fantasia com batalhas táticas, evolução de personagens e um mundo cheio de heróis lendários.

O Archdemon venceu. Os Guardiões caíram, e muitos deles foram corrompidos pelas trevas. Mas a esperança ainda vive — Aurora escapou do controle do inimigo. Agora, cabe a você reunir os heróis e restaurar o equilíbrio neste jogo de RPG completo.

• RPG com progressão, classes e batalhas táticas

Hero Wars: Alliance é um jogo de interpretação de papéis (RPG) em que você monta uma equipe com personagens de diferentes classes e facções, evolui seus atributos e habilidades, escolhe equipamentos e toma decisões que impactam o campo de batalha.

Cada herói tem um papel — tanque, suporte, mago, assassino — e habilidades ativas e passivas que se complementam em combates por turnos e lutas automáticas, como em muitos jogos de RPG estratégicos.

• Mundo de fantasia com história envolvente

Explore o Domínio — um mundo de fantasia dividido entre luz e trevas. A cada missão, novas camadas da história são reveladas: traições, redenções, lutas pelo poder.
Acompanhe missões principais, aventuras solo, histórias paralelas e participe de eventos RPG com narrativa e escolha de heróis.

• Evolua e personalize seus heróis

Colete mais de 80 heróis, evolua seus níveis, desbloqueie habilidades, melhore equipamentos e monte equipes personalizadas. O sistema de progressão é ideal para fãs de RPGs com foco em estratégia e construção de personagens.

• PvP JxJ para verdadeiros mestres táticos

Na Arena PvP (JxJ), enfrente jogadores do mundo todo em batalhas estratégicas. Use formações, counters e sinergias entre classes para alcançar o topo do ranking.

Participe da Seleção das Lendas — um modo JxJ tático com heróis aleatórios, onde só a estratégia define a vitória.

• PvE, Titãs e Guildas

Explore a Torre com chefes PvE, enfrente Titãs elementais com habilidades devastadoras, entre em uma Guilda e lute em guerras cooperativas com aliados.

Se você gosta de jogos de RPG com história, evolução de personagens, batalhas táticas e mundo de fantasia, Hero Wars: Alliance é o seu próximo desafio.

Baixe agora e viva uma verdadeira aventura RPG no celular.

Invade countries, conquer lands, survive wars and disasters, evolve and build a powerful civilization!

Manage the economy, hire ministers, form a government, impose taxes, issue and repay loans. Produce food, gold, iron, oil, uranium. Build plants, mines, derricks, factories. Build power plants and alternative power sources. Trade with other countries for better prices, research economic technologies to get better deals!

Manage every aspect of your country's development: education, infrastructure, science and research, culture, sports, housing, justice

🪖 Military Development

Build an invincible army to dominate battlefields, train troops, build military facilities. Manage internal security and safety: the Ministry of Defense, security service, police, and the National Guard.
Build your own nuclear program!

The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

From your small office you must watch the security cameras carefully. You have a very limited amount of electricity that you're allowed to use per night (corporate budget cuts, you know). That means when you run out of power for the night- no more security doors and no more lights! If something isn't right- namely if Freddybear or his friends aren't in their proper places, you must find them on the monitors and protect yourself if needed!

Can you survive five nights at Freddy's?

===

Supported Languages: English, Čeština, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Nederlands, Polski, Русский

Saints Row: The Third Remastered requires Android 13 or later. You need 19.3GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

My Boy! is a super fast and full-featured emulator to run GameBoy Advance games on Android devices, from very low-end phones to modern tablets. It emulates nearly all aspects of the real hardware, including linking devices for multiplayer games.

Highlights:
• Super fast emulation, thanks to the JIT recompiler.
• Very high game compatibility. Run nearly all games without a problem.
• Link cable emulation either on the same device, or across devices over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.
• Gyroscope/tilt/solar sensor and rumble emulation through your Android's hardware sensors and vibrator!
• Enter multilined GameShark/ActionReplay/CodeBreaker cheat codes and enable/disable them on the fly while the game is running.
• High-level BIOS emulation. No BIOS file needed.
• IPS/UPS ROM patching

• Cool video filters through the support of GLSL shaders.

• Clean & simple yet well-designed user interface. Seamlessly integrated with the latest Android.
• Create and switch to different screen-layout and key-mapping profiles.

name: Driving Zone: Germany Pro
summary: Driving simulator with German cars. Racing car games without ads and limits.
description:
Driving Zone: Germany Pro – the premium version of the popular car game and street racing simulator, without ads or limitations. Experience the thrill of driving legendary German cars with ultra-realistic physics and graphics.

Pro Version Features:
- 20,000 bonus coins.
- Completely ad-free. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no distractions.
- Free driving mode. Your car will never break down, allowing you to enjoy endless driving fun.
- Unified cloud save and progress synchronization with the free version of the game.

Explore a variety of game modes:
- Career Mode: Complete exciting missions like parking challenges, time-based races, overtaking in traffic, and long-distance driving.
- Driving School: Master essential driving skills in a test environment, navigating cones and learning advanced techniques.
- Street Racing: Compete on highways, city streets, or icy winter tracks with dynamic weather changes.
- Drift Mode: Perfect your drifting skills on sharp turns and earn points for style and precision.
- Drag Racing: Compete in high-speed, straight-line races on a 402-meter drag track.
- Replay Mode: Relive your best races and improve your strategy with cinematic replays.

Enhanced Tracks and Features:
The Pro version features many unique tracks, including:
- Bavarian Alps: Drive through challenging mountain roads with breathtaking views.
- Test Track: Learn driving mechanics in a controlled environment.
- Highway and city streets: Enjoy day or night drive on roads with dense traffic.
- Drag Strip: Push your car’s speed to the limit in drag races.

Additional Features:
- High-quality 3D graphics and ultra realistic car physics.
- Prototypes of legendary german cars with customization and tuning options.
- Dynamic day-night cycles and weather changes.
- Multiple camera angles: first-person, interior, cinematic views.
- Automatic cloud save for seamless progress syncing.

Start your engines and embark on the ultimate driving adventure without limits. Customize your car, master challenging tracks, and explore diverse gameplay modes in a premium, distraction-free experience.

Warning! This game is highly realistic, but it is not intended to teach or encourage street racing. Please drive carefully and responsibly in real life. Enjoy virtual driving in dense traffic, but always follow traffic rules and stay safe on real roads.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
summary: No place to run, and exactly one place to hide.
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!

In Five Nights at Freddy's 2, the old and aging animatronics are joined by a new cast of characters. They are kid-friendly, updated with the latest in facial recognition technology, tied into local criminal databases, and promise to put on a safe and entertaining show for kids and grown-ups alike!

What could go wrong?

As the new security guard working nights, your job is to monitor cameras and make sure nothing goes wrong after-hours. The previous guard has complained about the characters trying to get into the office (he has since been moved to day-shift). So to make your job easier, you've been provided with your very own empty Freddy Fazbear head, which should fool the animatronic characters into leaving you alone if they should accidentally enter your office.

As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

#MadeWithFusion

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Max Payne Mobile
summary: Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.
description:
Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists. 

The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

Max Payne Mobile for Android has been fully optimized for the NVIDIA® Tegra® 3 quad-core mobile processor with additional antistrophic texture filtering and enhanced lighting effects providing one of the most visually immersive Max Payne Mobile experiences available. 

Features:
• Max Payne's signature slow motion gunplay, Bullet Time® 
• Stunningly sharp, HD quality resolution and textures
• Gameplay tailored for touch screen devices
• Highly customizable controls 
• Multiple aiming modes
• Compatible with the GameStop Wireless Game Controller and select USB gamepads
• Integrated with Immersion Haptic Vibration Feedback
• Tailor your visual experience with adjustable graphic settings 
• Unlock cheats, track your stats and more with full Rockstar Games Social Club integration 

Max Payne Mobile is now available on:
Android Phones: Motorola Razr,  Razr Maxx, Motorola Atrix, Motorola Photon, Motorola Droid Bionic, HTC Rezound, HTC One X,  HTC One S,  HTC Evo 3D, HTC Sensation, HTC Droid Incredible 2,  Samsung Galaxy Nexus, Samsung Nexus S, Samsung Galaxy Note, Samsung S2, Samsung Galaxy R, Sony Xperia Play, Sony Xperia S, Sony Walkman Z Series Media Player

Android Tablets: Acer Iconia, Asus Eee Pad Transformer, Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime, LG Optimus Pad, Medion Lifetab, Motorola Xoom, Samsung Galaxy Tab 8.9 / 10.1, Sony Tablet S, Sony Tablet P, Toshiba Thrive, HTC Flyer, HTC Jetstream

For those using the "Skip to Level" cheat, we recommend that you have weapons in your inventory; as you will start a new level with your current weapon set.  

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese.

Please ensure you have at least 1.33 GB of free space before installing Max Payne Mobile.

Find out more about Max Payne 3: http://www.rockstargames.com/maxpayne3

name: Vector Classic
summary: Join the breathtaking chase!
description:
Parkour-inspired action game is now available! Vector lets you break free and run! Don't get caught!

Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free. Run, vault, slide and climb using extraordinary techniques based on the urban ninja sport of Parkour all while being chased by “Big Brother” who’s sole purpose is to capture you and bring you back.

Inspired by the practice and principles of Parkour, Vector’s intuitive controls please players of all levels, and sophisticated level designs challenge the most demanding players with fast-paced timing puzzles as the traceur “flows” over the dystopian rooftops.

Game Features:
- Arcade gameplay from the makers of the Shadow Fight games
- Astoundingly lifelike Parkour-inspired moves made possible by Cascadeur animation tools
- 40+ challenging levels
- Quick to learn, challenging to master

name: Bike Mayhem Mountain Racing
summary: Rip down tons of mountains while busting tricks on your custom bike!
description:
Downhill mountain bike racing like never before. Race down beautiful trails, smashing over rocks and roots, boosting huge jumps, scoring insane trick combos, unlocking better bikes and gear for bragging rights as the King of the Mountain!

The best mobile bike game, Bike Mayhem Extreme Mountain Racing! 

Compete in timed races or freestyle trick events on 19 different mountains and over 100 trails inspired by real world locations.

Unlock over 80 items of gear to add style your rider and tune your bike for speed, agility, strength, and energy for each trail.

Experience realistic physics and plush bike suspension as your bike eats up the rough stuff and softens the landings of big jumps and drops. 
High speeds and big jumps means huge crashes where your rider will ragdoll tumble down the trail. Use your finger to pick up you rider throw him even further.

Share your races with your friends. Challenge them to beat your times! 

Brought to you by the makers of the epically popular Motocross racing game: Moto X Mayhem, which reached #1 Paid App worldwide and was a Top 5 Racing game for over a year! 

FEATURES: 

- 100+ Beautiful mountain trails for all styles of riding
- 80+ Gear items for your rider and MTB bike 
- Frame and wheel upgrades that impact game play
- Epic bike crashes, fun rag doll physics and active bike suspension
- Tricks, bunny hops and flips! 
- Addictive gameplay 
- Powerful online leaderboards

TIPS: 

- If you use check points, you will get a maximum of one star. Stay on your bike to achieve 3 stars! 
- Lean to add flips into your trick combo. 
- Wheelie into and out of a jump to add to your trick combo.
- Hold down the pump/hop button when entering a downhill section to get a boost in speed.
- Wheelies do not drain your energy
- The timer doesn't start until you start to pedal the bike or brake! 
- Use your finger to grab the rider and toss him around the map when you're on or off the bike. 
- Make sure you pick the right frame and wheel combination to get the best score for each trail.
-Use boosters to help you through a difficult trail or to get the top position on the leaderboard.


See a video of this crazy action packed mountain bike game at: http://www.youtube.com/BestFreeGamesInc

Follow us @
www.bestfreegames.mobi
facebook.com/bikemayhem
twitter.com/BestFreeGamesCo

name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
summary: Grow your agricultural empire with 100+ authentic machines!
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

Farming Simulator 23 will be released on May 23, 2023, and is the latest official game in the successful simulation series available for mobile devices.

name: Bloons TD 6
summary: Smash Hit Tower Defense Game
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

HUGE CONTENT!
* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

Now those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!

Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. 

Ninja Kiwi Community:
We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative, at https://support.ninjakiwi.com.

Streamers and Video Creators: 
Ninja Kiwi is actively promoting channel creators on YouTube and Twitch! If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and tell us about your channel at streamers@ninjakiwi.com.

name: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redu
summary: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux - Post-Apocalyptic Action Shooter
description:
Survive deadly combat and stealth in the poisoned wasteland of Chernobyl Zone. Play as Serioga, lead your people to safety in the old subway tunnels, and fight for survival in this immersive post-apocalyptic world.

Long Description:

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is an epic, story-driven first person post-apocalyptic shooter from AGaming+. In 2014, an apocalypse destroyed most of humanity and turned the Earth's surface into a poisoned wasteland. It's now 2034, and as the surface of the Earth freezes, people must seek shelter in the old subway tunnels.

You play as Serioga, a survivor born just before the apocalypse, who must lead your people to safety and fight for survival against terrifying enemies. Explore the dangerous world, scavenge for resources, and engage in deadly combat and stealth.

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is one of the most immersive game worlds ever created, with stunning graphics and realistic sound effects. Can you survive and lead your people to safety? Play Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux now and find out.

name: My Child Lebensborn
summary: Help your child, in a story-driven parenting game based on true events.
description:
You adopt a young Lebensborn child in Norway after WW2, but parenting will be hard as your child grows up in a hostile and hateful environment. 
Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the heavy inheritance of the German occupation, so they will find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom?

Polygon: "My Child Lebensborn tells a disturbing tale about innocents in the aftermath of WW2”
LevelUp: “The strongest game experience that I have ever had.”

My Child Lebensborn is a BAFTA-winning parenting simulation with original gameplay and a heartbreaking story. It has challenged millions of players to experience how hard it is to keep a child safe when they are seen as symbols of a hated enemy.

See a different side of the war, inspired by the true stories of the Lebensborn children. Discover how hatred of our enemies continues to create victims, even after victory. Discover their past and support them in the present. You must balance your time and resources to provide for your child. You will find answers to the hard questions; about their history, the hatred, bullying and the passing of blame.

Feed, clothe, teach, and comfort your child as you navigate the prejudices of a hostile community. Every decision shapes who they become.

You can make a difference.

Key Features:
- Adopt a boy or girl, and support them through a defining year of their life.
- Influence the child’s feelings, personality and worldview through your choices.
- Earn money as you work, then cook, craft, forage and play.
- Use your time and meagre resources wisely.
- Look for the effects of your choices in your child’s expressions and body language.
- Explore a gripping storyline based upon true events.

Parts of the game's proceeds are donated to help protect Children Born of War (children born of enemy soldiers and local women).

This game presents difficult and heavy topics, not suitable for young children.

If you loved caring for Karin or Klaus in this game, you can continue with them in the sequel "My Child New Beginnings".

For technical support, please contact us at support@sareptastudio.com

name: The Room
summary: The definitive puzzle experience
description:
Welcome to The Room, a physical puzzler, wrapped in a mystery game, inside a beautifully tactile 3D world.

*****************

How are you, old friend? If you’re reading this, then it worked. I only hope you can still forgive me. 

We’ve never seen eye to eye on my research, but you must put such things behind you. You are the only one to whom I can turn. You must come at once, for we are all in great peril. I trust you remember the house? My study is the highest room. 

Press forward with heart. There is no way back now. 

AS. 

****** 
Fireproof Games are very proud to bring you our greatest creation, a mind-bending journey filled with beauty, peril and mystery in equal measure. Be transported into a unique space that blends spellbinding visuals with intriguing problems to solve.

• Unsettlingly realistic graphics: Vibrant natural-looking visuals perfected for mobile displays.
• Spine-tingling single finger controls: touch controls so natural you can play with one digit, to fully navigate this mysteriously beautiful 3D world.
• Fantastical pick-up-and-play design: Easy to start, hard to put down, the secrets of The Room will immerse you before you even know you're playing.
• Compelling layers of mystery: think you know what you're looking at? Think again.

name: Football Referee Simulator
summary: Exploring Football from a Unique Perspective
description:
Football Referee Simulator—the groundbreaking mobile game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

*** Experience Real-Time Game Simulation! ***

Step onto the pitch and play a pivotal role in the game's outcome! With real-time simulation, every decision you make holds the power to shape the course of the match!

** Craft Your Journey and Elevate Your Character! **

Shape your own persona and chase after your goals! Stay updated with post-game news, claim prestigious awards, and elevate your personal stats!

* Explore a Vast Football Universe! *

Immerse yourself in a world featuring over 100 diverse clubs, 16 national teams, and a multitude of leagues and tournaments waiting to be conquered.

No ads. No in-game purchases. All content is unlocked upon purchase. Football Referee Simulator offers seamless gameplay without interruptions.

Localized in 11 languages—English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Indonesian, Polish, Greek and Russian—immerse yourself in the game in your preferred language!

name: Bendy and the Ink Machine
summary: A Puzzle-Action-Horror Set in a Mysteriously Sketchy Studio
description:
Bendy and the Ink Machine® is a first person puzzle-action-horror game with a unique cartoon atmosphere and an intense, frightening storyline that keeps you guessing throughout.

Henry was the lead animator at Joey Drew Studios in its 1930s heyday, a studio that was best known for producing animated cartoons of their most popular and beloved character, Bendy. Many years later Henry receives a mysterious invitation from Joey Drew himself to return to the old cartoon workshop. Journey deep into the sketchy madness of this twisted cartoon nightmare. 

Fight the darkness. Escape the Ink Demon. Fear the Machine.

• Varied Game Play! - First person combat, horror, puzzles, stealth and numerous hidden secrets.
• A Beautiful Cartoon World! - Lovingly crafted by a small indie studio.
• A Global Bendy Community! - Delve deep into the mystery and join the discussion at joeydrewstudios.com

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 1
summary: The Official Poppy Playtime Mobile Game!
description:
You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

Welcome to Playtime Co.!
Playtime Co. was once the king of the toy manufacturing industry... until everybody inside of the factory one day disappeared into thin air. Now, years later, you must explore the abandoned factory and uncover the truth.

The Toys
The toys of Playtime Co. are a lively bunch! From Bot to Huggy, Catbee to Poppy, Playtime does it all! As long as you're at Playtime Co., why not pay the toys a little visit? You might just make a few friends...

name: Incredibox
summary: Create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers!
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

name: Underworld Office
summary: Are You Bored? Play our Masterpiece Ghosts Story, Visual Novel & Adventure Game

Share our ghost games, hidden story games, chat games with your friends and family, and let them excited too.

name: MA 2 – President Simulator PRO
summary: Build nuclear weapon, wage wars, strategize and become the strongest leader
description:
Play the hit epic combat strategy game adventure where you face new challenges, fight stronger opponents, lead turn-based battles, protect your president status. Invade and conquer countries, grow a bustling economy, compete for 1st places in economy, culture and military power

Modern Age 2 - President Simulator PRO is the best way to become a real president, lead real politics, manage your civilization. Plan your tactics, discover new technologies in the beset single player game for managing population, diplomacy, finances

CONTROL POPULATION

Monitor the president's rating to avoid riots, protests and revolutions. Build factories, mines, farms, bakeries, gardens, power plants, oil derricks, greenhouses, power plants, green energy. Fund the Ministry of Culture; hold concerts, film festivals, carnivals, the Davis Cup, FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games 

MANAGE MINISTRIES

Fund and develop the Ministry of Health, Education, Infrastructure, Culture, Sports, Justice, police, ministry of defense, security service, national guard and others that help improve lives of citizens. Develop the Ministry of Tourism to turn your country into a world tourism hub, attracting millions of tourists. Build build wonders of the world: Eiffel Tower, Colosseum, Big Ben, Statue of Liberty

CONTROL FINANCES

Manage taxes, lend with interest, trade goods and resources, ask for help, take loans, research new economic technologies. 

WARFARE

Build army and navy, train soldiers, gain experience in battles, send saboteurs and spies, research new war technologies. Build barracks, arsenals, airfields, hangars, shipyards, and warehouses. Study and build nuclear weapons, launch a nuclear strike on the enemy!

INTERNATIONAL POLITICS

Find friends among other countries, join international organizations, sign non-aggression pacts, defense alliances, trade and research agreements, open embassies. Vote in the UN and the UN Security Council, impose sanctions, and propose resolutions for voting

FACE CHALLENGES

Defend against pirate and terrorist attacks, fight disasters, epidemics, pandemics, protests, demonstrations, and economic downturns. A true president and leader is always ready to help their citizens in difficult times

Enjoy government management and realistic strategy game, Modern Age 2 - President Simulator is exactly what you've been looking for! Make strategic decisions and change course of history!

Turn your state into the most famous and powerful in the world, become the Best President!

*The game is designed for entertainment purposes only. Any similarities to the real world, real people and geopolitical situations are coincidental*

The game is also available on iOS, iPhone, iPad, PC

name: US Truck Driving: Cargo Game
summary: Explore highways, transport freight, and experience life on the open road.
description:
The road stretches beyond the horizon. Your truck is loaded, the route is ready, and a new journey is about to begin.

Step into the world of long-distance truck driving and experience the challenge of transporting cargo across European-inspired roads. Take control of powerful trucks, navigate highways and countryside routes, complete deliveries, and build your journey one successful haul at a time.

From busy roads and city routes to peaceful countryside highways, every journey brings a different driving experience. Plan your route, control your truck, protect your cargo, and enjoy the freedom of spending miles behind the wheel.

🌍 EXPLORE EUROPEAN-INSPIRED ROADS

Leave the starting point behind and discover a variety of road environments inspired by European driving journeys.

Travel through urban areas, countryside routes, highways, industrial zones, and long stretches of open road. Every route gives you a new destination to reach and another opportunity to improve your driving.

🚛 TAKE CONTROL OF THE TRUCK

A heavy truck demands careful control.

Accelerate smoothly, manage your speed, take corners with care, and keep your vehicle under control while carrying valuable cargo. Learn how the truck responds to different roads and become more confident with every journey.

📦 HAUL CARGO ACROSS LONG ROUTES

Your job is simple: pick up the load and deliver it safely.

Accept transportation tasks, collect different types of cargo, follow the route, and reach your destination. Long-distance deliveries can test your patience, precision, and ability to stay in control throughout the journey.

🛣️ MASTER THE OPEN HIGHWAY

There is a special feeling when the city disappears behind you and the highway opens ahead.

Cruise across long roads, manage your truck through changing routes, and enjoy the rhythm of long-distance transportation. Keep your attention on the road and make every mile part of your trucking adventure.

🏙️ DRIVE THROUGH DIFFERENT ENVIRONMENTS

Your journey can take you through more than just highways.

• 🏙️ Navigate urban roads and busy areas
• 🛣️ Travel across long highway routes
• 🌄 Explore countryside landscapes
• 🏭 Visit industrial and cargo locations
• 📦 Complete transportation deliveries
• 🚛 Handle heavy truck driving challenges
• 🎯 Reach destinations safely
• 🗺️ Follow routes across different environments

🎯 EVERY DELIVERY HAS A PURPOSE

A successful truck driver needs more than speed.

Choose your route carefully, maintain control, and make sure your cargo reaches its destination. Tight turns, long roads, traffic, and different environments can all make a journey more challenging.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
summary: This time, the terror has followed you home!
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows. Playing as a child whose role is yet unknown, you must safeguard yourself until 6am by watching the doors, as well as warding off unwanted creatures that may venture into your closet or onto the bed behind you.

You have only a flashlight to protect yourself. It will scare away things that may be creeping at the far end of the hallways, but be careful, and listen. If something has crept too close, then shining lights in its eyes will be your end.

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

#MadeWithFusion

name: Don't Starve Together
summary: A multiplayer spooky survival
description:
Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

Enter a strange and unexplored world full of odd creatures, hidden dangers, and ancient secrets. Gather resources to craft items and build structures that match your survival style. Play your way as you unravel the mysteries of "The Constant". Cooperate with your friends in a private game, or find new friends online. Work with other players to survive the harsh environment, or strike out on your own.

Survive together stranded on a gloomy world full of surprises and mysteries, and craft your way out through the darkness. Do whatever it takes, but most importantly, Don't Starve.

FEATURES
– Do what you can to survive in this spooky and cartoonish world and choose between a large catalog of characters with their own backstory and playstyle.
– There’s safety in numbers: these lands are full of dangers and monsters so your odds are greater surrounded by friends in local co-op or online partners you meet along the way.
– Tend to your needs: build a settlement, farm and hunt for food, craft better gear to defend yourself and go in expedition but don’t forget to take a break in the flowers once in a while or you’ll start to lose your mind!
– Who put you in these dangerous surroundings, and why? You’ll need to explore "The Constant" and crack its puzzling mysteries to find out and escape this gloomy place.
– Play your own way: pick the mode you prefer to adjust the difficulty by tweaking a large panel of parameters.
– Choose from a large variety of cosmetic items for your favorite characters: survive, but in style! (available in in-app purchases)

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
– Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
– Google Play Games achievements
– Shared Unlocks with PC & Console - Link your accounts and share your unlocked skins and characters with PC and Console
– Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
– Compatible with controllers

name: Shadow of Death: Dark Knight
summary: Unite against the Shadow & Become an Legends Soul Knight in Offline ARPG Games
description:
🏆 Premium feature: Unlock all 4 characters including the fan-favourite Lunae - the beautiful Keeper of Time and Space with a powerful high-speed scythe attack!
🎯 Note: This is a stand-alone game. You cannot transfer your data from the free version to the paid version.

A Brand New Dark Fantasy Epic Game
Plunge into the darkness and experience the great pocket sized fantasy RPG of the ages. Whip out that shadow blade and select a customizable dark knight to go on a side scroller adventure anywhere at anytime. Freely experiment with multiple gameplay styles, wicked rare armor sets, and robust skill trees to create the powerful shadow knight possible. An offline fighting game with the soul of a console RPG is not what this generation of gamers deserves, but needs! The shadow of war is rising, will you accept the challenge?

Choice to the Players
Choose from a cast of four unique shadow knights each representing a vastly different play style. Whether players want to slash or force projectile their way to victory is in their hands, quite literally! Delve into a robust skill tree and deep inventory system that encourages endless combat experimentation and customization. We even have a young boy's soul in a hulking suit of armor.

Conquer the Darkness in Style
Inspired by classic fighting games and modern action RPGs, combat is a high-octane blend of magic and weapons based hack and slash gameplay. An intuitive touch screen interface provides different options to strategize combat and devastate enemies. The unique battle system is accessible for any player yet deep enough to satisfy the hardcore action RPG fans. What are you waiting for? Grab that mystical dark sword and plunge into darkness!

A Beautiful Ruined World
Driven by an all new animation system and graphics engine, players are going to be saying, "I can't believe it's not a console game." That's right, the game looks that good! Optimized for mobile gaming, the gothic fantasy world of Aurora is uniquely cel shaded to deliver jaw dropping magical effects and epic combat sequences to life.

Play Anywhere, Anytime
We put the “pocket” in pocket sized RPGs! Experience the thrill of combat anywhere, anytime as Shadow of Death is an offline game. No need to be online to defeat the shadows.

Challenge the Universe
When beating down shadow monsters just does not cut it anymore, take your game online! Vie for ultimate supremacy as you battle with other players in the Arena.

Unlock the Dream Team
Tired of grinding to unlock the next character? The paid version of Shadow of Death has all four shadow warriors unlocked from the start. Now players can conquer the darkness like never before and get to the good stuff way faster.

Story: A Dark Knight's Journey
Aurora, once a prosperous kingdom has fallen. An ancient darkness reborn savages the land with brute force. Crops decay, winds scream with rage, and the dead stir.
In his lust for power and forbidden knowledge, a king has forsaken his people to ruin. The people cry for hope.
A lone knight, cleansed of memory but driven by conviction is all that stands between utter annihilation. Marked by destiny, he walks alone towards the whispering shadows.

Take your game further and level up with us! Engage our team on social media for the latest events to get gift codes, rare armor sets, loads of crystals, and other juicy prizes.

name: This War of Mine
summary: Control your survivors and manage your shelter. Craft weapons and items.
description:
The Little Ones expansion is available now as an in-app purchase!

"If you've not already played this brilliant, heart-wrenching game, then mobile is as good a place as any to let it completely destroy you." - , 9/10, Pocket Gamer UK

"This War of Mine isn’t exactly “fun,” but it’s definitely a game worth playing." , 9/10, 148apps

In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle. 

The pace of This War of Mine is imposed by the day and night cycle. During the day snipers outside stop you from leaving your refuge, so you need to focus on maintaining your hideout: crafting, trading and taking care of your survivors. At night, take one of your civilians on a mission to scavenge through a set of unique locations for items that will help you stay alive. 

Make life-and-death decisions driven by your conscience. Try to protect everybody from your shelter or sacrifice some of them for longer-term survival. During war, there are no good or bad decisions; there is only survival. The sooner you realize that, the better.

Key Features:
•    Inspired by real-life events 
•    Control your survivors and manage your shelter 
•    Craft weapons, alcohol, beds or stoves – anything that helps you survive 
•    Make decisions - an often unforgiving and emotionally difficult experience 
•    Randomized world and characters every time you start a new game 
•    Charcoal-stylized aesthetics to complement the game's theme

The Little Ones:

The newly delivered expansion explores the hardships of wartime survival as seen from an entirely new perspective―that of a child. This DLC puts you in charge of a group of adults and children stuck in a besieged city, struggling with basic necessities. TWoM: The Little Ones focuses not only on the reality of enduring war, but also on how even in times of conflict, kids are still kids: they laugh, cry, play, and see the world differently. In addition to thinking about survival, you'll have to summon your inner child to understand how to protect the little ones. Their youth, and their future, are in your hands.

• Experience the biggest expansion to This War of Mine
• Protect innocent children
• Craft toys, play with kids, and be the caretaker they need
• Meet new adult civilians in scenarios with children

Expand your This War of Mine journey with This War of Mine: Stories Ep 1: Father's Promise. A standalone game that offers a brand new, distinctive experience with additional game mechanics and several hours of thought-provoking gameplay. It tells a story of a family’s struggle to preserve the last pieces of humanity in times of despair and cruelty.

Supported languages:
English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Portugese-Brazil

System requirements:
GPU: Adreno 320 and higher, Tegra 3 and higher, PowerVR SGX 544 and higher.
RAM: At least 1 GB RAM is required.
Other devices may work depending on screen resolution and amount of background apps running.

name: Aerofly FS Global
summary: Fly around the world with Aerofly FS Global Flight Simulator
description:
Aerofly FS Global is a highly realistic Flight Simulator in PC-quality for your mobile device for beginner and professional flight sim pilots. Explore the world of flying with extremely detailed and accurately simulated airliners, fully interactive 3D cockpits and realistic aircraft systems. Fly with complex airliners, helicopters, business jets, fighter jets and warbirds, general aviation aircraft, aerobatic stuntplanes and gliders across the photorealistic landscape.

**IMPORTANT NOTE BEFORE PURCHASING**

After downloading Aerofly FS from Google Play Store, Aerofly FS needs to download additional data before you can fly. Ensure you are connected to the Internet through WiFi and have at least 8 GB of free storage before purchasing.

▶ AIRCRAFT

25 aircraft available as in-app purchase:

• Concorde
• CRJ-900

• King Air C90 GTx

• UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter

▶ GLOBAL SCENERY
Explore the world with our global scenery streaming! Global streaming is available as prepaid subscription and adds world wide scenery coverage and other global features:
